title: Minimum Capacity Box
summary: Given an array of box capacities and an item size, find the index of the box with the smallest capacity that can hold the item.
statement: Given an array of box capacities and an item size, find the index of the box with the smallest capacity that can hold the item. If multiple boxes have the same minimum capacity, choose the one with the smallest index. If no box can hold the item, return -1.
constraints: Choose a box whose capacity is at least itemSize.
Minimize chosen capacity, breaking equal-capacity ties by smaller index.
hints: Filter indices whose capacities meet the size.
Rank fitting indices by capacity then index.
An empty candidate list yields the required -1.
editorial: An empty candidate list yields the required -1.

tests.explanation: Capacity three at index two is the smallest fitting box.
The equal minimum fits at indices zero and one, so choose zero.
